items.title: WebMCP, Explained with a To-Do App
items.summary: Ask an AI agent in your browser to add three items to a to-do list, and watch what it does. It reads the page, looks for something that resembles an input, types, presses Enter, then checks whether anything happened.That's how most agents use the web today. There is no manual to follow. WebMCP is a new browser proposal that changes this. Your page tells the agent what it can do, in a format the agent understands, and the agent calls those actions directly.
